company.name: TRU
company.shortDescription: TRU operates as a digital lending startup.
company.description: TRU operates as a digital lending startup. TRU uses proprietary AI-based credit scoring engine, enables users to apply for virtual credit through its mobile app that they can then use to purchase different products.

productsAndServices.description: A service allowing users to purchase consumer goods and services and pay in installments over up to 36 months, with no down-payment and starting at 0% interest.
productsAndServices.name: Buy Now, Pay Later

productsAndServices.description: Users can get instant credit approval by downloading the app and providing their ID, or by applying in-store through partner merchants.
productsAndServices.name: Instant Credit Approval

productsAndServices.description: Users can settle their monthly installments through various methods such as Fawry, Aman, Masary, e-wallets like Vodafone Cash, or with a credit card.
productsAndServices.name: Flexible Installment Payments

productsAndServices.description: A program for merchants to become Shahry certified partners, allowing them to offer installment payment options to their customers and potentially increase sales.
productsAndServices.name: Partner Merchant Program

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $650,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,831,671 to $4,831,671, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Souhoola, Contact, MNT-Halan.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
